verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh screens customers against sanctions, watchlists, PEPs and adverse media from one global database through a single API, with sync, async and batch modes. Results surface in one case-management review surface where alerts are prioritised and decided, or they can be pulled via the API and webhooks. Missing for 10: no evidence it performs the identity verification itself, so screening 'as part of the same verification' under one vendor is unproven; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
